dct_title_s: King County, Washington : street name annotations
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington street name annotation derived from the King County GIS cadastral base framework layer (RECDNET).
Purpose: This data set is an annotation layer for street names created from the RECDNET library layer for the initial, prototype King County GIS Center Web Map Portal.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
Data credit: Created by Raymond Passage, reviewed by Bruce Thomas.
